Extract the region column of an atlas

Source: R/atlas_utils.R
atlas_regions.Rd

Extract the region column of an atlas

Usage

atlas_regions(x)

brain_regions(x)

Arguments

x

brain atlas

Value

The region column of core, unchanged: one element per core row, in core row order, with repeats and NAs retained. It is therefore row-aligned with atlas_labels() and atlas_names(). Use unique() for the distinct set. A zero-length character vector when the atlas carries no region column.

See also

Other atlas accessors: atlas_centerlines(), atlas_geom(), atlas_geometry_type(), atlas_labels(), atlas_meshes(), atlas_names(), atlas_palette(), atlas_polygons(), atlas_sf(), atlas_type(), atlas_vertices(), atlas_views(), legacy_region_map()
